notes.title: Up to 80% OFF in the RoShamBo arena shop!
notes.content:
It's time to update your gear, fighters! RSBucks, teeth and power-ups are now with up to 80% discount in the in-game shop for a limited time. Don't miss your chance to conquer the arena. 

Besides the Sales, we release our first update right now. We've been working on the game since it's release aiming to make it better for you. Thanks to your comments we made some changes that will improve the experience and make the game even more fun to play. 

List of changes - 
[list]
    [*]In-game shop sale is live
    [*]Rematches are now limited to 3 matches with the same opponent
    [*]User interface bugs that blocked the Campaign mode fixed
    [*]Matchmaking system is fixed and is now searching for opponents according to their levels in tournaments and duels
    [*]Adding and dueling friends feature is temporaly turned off
    [*]Saving system bugs fixed
    [*]Other minor bugs fixes
[/list]
